title: WORKNC workflows and connector status
description: Explore WORKNC workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Hexagon

WORKNC

WORKNC supports automated CNC programming for complex surface and mould machining.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare mould geometry

Start from the selected part, stock, machine or cell layout. In the intended WORKNC preview, prepare mould geometry; the visible result is a process setup with work coordinates, resources and target geometry visible. Review orientation, reach, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Generate automated toolpaths

Begin with the chosen operations, tools or robot tasks. In the intended WORKNC preview, generate automated toolpaths; the visible result is a generated path or production sequence over the same setup. Review clearance, collisions, limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Review collision and stock

Use the simulated material removal, robot motion or process results. In the intended WORKNC preview, review collision and stock; the visible result is a verification view with remaining stock, reach or cycle data exposed. Review collisions, code target, cycle time and safe human approval before accepting or exporting it.
